semantics.definition: One tile for one 10 m by 10 m section of the land, its corners rounded by 1 m, matte black, with a border 0.1 m wide in Eidos’s border colour. Your words, 21 Nov.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one base tile every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Cover one section of the land; be what the platforms, the drone’s colours and the stage are made from.

measure.width: how far it runs along x
measure.breadth: how far it runs along y
measure.corner-radius: how far its corners are rounded
